Fit_INLA_single <- function(Data,
                            dataset_name,
                            Raster_path,
                            output_root,
                            covariate_names = c("Population", "Malaria", "Urbanization",
                                                "Consanguinity", "EFI", "Counselling"),
                            transformation_log = NULL,
                            n_posterior = 1000,
                            verbose = TRUE) {
                            
                            dataset_output_dir <- file.path(output_root, dataset_name)
                            final_output_dir <- file.path(dataset_output_dir, "Final")
                            
                            if (!dir.exists(dataset_output_dir)) {dir.create(dataset_output_dir, recursive = TRUE)}
                            if (!dir.exists(final_output_dir)) {dir.create(final_output_dir, recursive = TRUE)}
                            
                            if (!inherits(Data, "sf")) {Data <- sf::st_as_sf(Data, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)}
                            
                            missing_covariates <- setdiff(covariate_names, names(Data))
                            
                            if (length(missing_covariates) > 0) {stop("Missing covariate(s) in ", dataset_name, ": ", paste(missing_covariates, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)}
                            
                            required_columns <- c("total", "count", "value", "longitude", "latitude", "geo_admin0")
                            missing_required <- setdiff(required_columns, names(Data))
                            
                            if (length(missing_required) > 0) {stop("Missing required column(s) in ", dataset_name, ": ", paste(missing_required, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)}
                            
                            log_transform_safe <- function(x, log_base = exp(1)) {x <- as.numeric(x)
                                                                                  min_x <- suppressWarnings(min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
                                                                                  
                                                                                  if (!is.finite(min_x)) {return(x)}
                                                                                  if (min_x <= 0) {shift <- abs(min_x) + 1
                                                                                  return(log(x + shift, base = log_base))}
                                                                                  
                                                                                  log(x, base = log_base)}
                            
                            transformed_covariates_for_dataset <- character(0)
                            
                            if (!is.null(transformation_log)) {transformed_covariates_for_dataset <- transformation_log %>%
                                                                                                     dplyr::filter(Dataset == dataset_name,
                                                                                                                   Log_transformed == TRUE) %>%
                                                                                                     dplyr::pull(Covariate) %>%
                                                                                                     unique()}
                            
                            # Geographic domain
                            Raster <- raster::raster(Raster_path)
                            temp <- raster::projectRaster(Raster, crs = raster::crs(Raster),
                                                          res = c(5 / 111, 5 / 85),
                                                          method = "ngb",
                                                          filename = file.path(dataset_output_dir, "Final/Raster.tif"),
                                                          overwrite = TRUE)
                            Raster <- temp
                            
                            ADM0 <- ADM0_shapes %>%
                                    sf::st_transform(crs = raster::crs(Raster))
                            
                            if ("geo_admin0" %in% names(ADM0) && "geo_admin0" %in% names(Data)) {ADM0 <- ADM0 %>%
                                                                                                         dplyr::filter(geo_admin0 %in% unique(Data$geo_admin0))}
                            
                            Domain <- ADM0 %>%
                                      sf::st_union() %>%
                                      sf::st_as_sf()
                            
                            Domain_sp <- Domain %>%
                                         as("Spatial")
                            
                            Raster <- raster::mask(raster::crop(Raster, Domain_sp), Domain_sp)
                            rm(temp)
                            
                            # Sampled and unsampled coordinates
                            Sampled_coords <- as.data.frame(sf::st_coordinates(Data))
                            
                            Sampled <- Sampled_coords %>%
                                       dplyr::mutate(ID = seq_len(nrow(Sampled_coords))) %>%
                                       dplyr::bind_cols(Data %>%
                                                        sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                        dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(covariate_names)))
                            
                            Unsampled_sp <- raster::rasterToPoints(Raster, spatial = TRUE)
                            Unsampled_xy <- data.frame(X = Unsampled_sp$x,
                                                       Y = Unsampled_sp$y)
                            
                            extract_unsampled_covariate <- function(covariate_name, xy) {transform_if_needed <- function(raw_val,
                                                                                                                         var_name) {if (var_name %in% transformed_covariates_for_dataset) {return(log_transform_safe(raw_val))}
                                                                                        raw_val}
                            
                            if (covariate_name %in% names(Covariates)) {raw_val <- raster::extract(Covariates[[covariate_name]], xy)
                                                                        val <- transform_if_needed(raw_val, covariate_name)
                                                                        return(val)}
                            
                            if (stringr::str_detect(covariate_name, "_x_")) {vars <- stringr::str_split(covariate_name, "_x_", simplify = TRUE)
                                                                             var1 <- vars[1]
                                                                             var2 <- vars[2]
                                                                             
                                                                             if (!(var1 %in% names(Covariates))) {warning("Missing raster covariate for interaction parent: ", var1)
                                                                                                                  return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(xy)))}
                                                                             
                                                                             if (!(var2 %in% names(Covariates))) {warning("Missing raster covariate for interaction parent: ", var2)
                                                                                                                  return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(xy)))}
                                                                             
                                                                             raw_val1 <- raster::extract(Covariates[[var1]], xy)
                                                                             raw_val2 <- raster::extract(Covariates[[var2]], xy)
                                                                             
                                                                             val1 <- transform_if_needed(raw_val1, var1)
                                                                             val2 <- transform_if_needed(raw_val2, var2)
                                                                             return(val1 * val2)}
                            
                            warning("Covariate not found in raster stack or interaction format: ", covariate_name)
                            rep(NA_real_, nrow(xy))}
                            
                            Unsampled <- Unsampled_xy %>%
                                         dplyr::mutate(ID = seq(from = nrow(Sampled) + 1, to = nrow(Sampled) + nrow(Unsampled_xy))) %>%
                                         dplyr::bind_cols(purrr::map_dfc(covariate_names,
                                                                         function(v) {val <- extract_unsampled_covariate(v, Unsampled_xy)
                                                                                      setNames(data.frame(val), v)}))
                            
                            # Mesh construction
                            lonlat3D <- function(lon, lat) {cbind(cos((lon / 180) * pi) * cos((lat / 180) * pi),
                                                                  sin((lon / 180) * pi) * cos((lat / 180) * pi),
                                                                  sin((lat / 180) * pi))}
                            
                            true.radius.of.earth <- 6371
                            ADM0_mesh <- ADM0
                            
                            ee <- raster::extent(as(ADM0_mesh, "Spatial"))
                            r0 <- as.numeric(0.05 * fields::rdist.earth(matrix(c(ee[1], ee[3]), ncol = 2),
                                                                        matrix(c(ee[2], ee[4]), ncol = 2),
                                                                        miles = FALSE,
                                                                        R = true.radius.of.earth))
                            Boundary_sf <- ADM0_mesh %>%
                                           sf::st_union() %>%
                                           sf::st_boundary() %>%
                                           sf::st_cast("LINESTRING")
                            
                            Segments <- lapply(sf::st_geometry(Boundary_sf),
                                               function(line) {coords <- sf::st_coordinates(line)
                                                               loc <- lonlat3D(coords[, 1], coords[, 2])
                                                               
                                                               INLA::inla.mesh.segment(loc = loc, is.bnd = TRUE)})
                            
                            Boundary_loc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Segments, function(x) x$loc))
                            
                            Indexing <- list()
                            Offset <- 0
                            
                            for (s in Segments) {Indexing[[length(Indexing) + 1]] <- matrix(s$idx + Offset,
                                                                                            ncol = ncol(s$idx))
                            
                            Offset <- Offset + nrow(s$loc)}
                            
                            Indexing <- do.call(rbind, Indexing)
                            Boundary <- INLA::inla.mesh.segment(loc = Boundary_loc, idx = Indexing, is.bnd = TRUE)

                            Mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(loc = lonlat3D(Sampled[, 1], Sampled[, 2]),
                                                 boundary = Boundary,    
                                                 cutoff = 50 / true.radius.of.earth,
                                                 offset = c(500, 1000) / true.radius.of.earth,
                                                 max.edge = c(100, 1000) / true.radius.of.earth)
                            
                            # Projector matrix
                            A_Sampled <- INLA::inla.spde.make.A(mesh = Mesh,
                                                                loc = lonlat3D(Sampled[, 1], Sampled[, 2]))
                            
                            A_Unsampled <- INLA::inla.spde.make.A(mesh = Mesh,
                                                                  loc = lonlat3D(Unsampled[, 1], Unsampled[, 2]))
                            
                            # SPDE
                            SPDE <- INLA::inla.spde2.pcmatern(mesh = Mesh,
                                                              alpha = 2,
                                                              prior.range = c(r0 / true.radius.of.earth, 0.01),
                                                              prior.sigma = c(3, 0.01))
                            
                            # Spatial index
                            S_Index <- INLA::inla.spde.make.index(name = "s",
                                                                  n.spde = SPDE$n.spde)
                            
                            # Stack
                            effect_data <- data.frame(Intercept = 1,
                                                      Sampled[, covariate_names, drop = FALSE],
                                                      check.names = FALSE)
                            
                            Stack <- INLA::inla.stack(tag = "point",
                                                      data = list(y = Data$count, Sample = Data$total),
                                                      A = list(A_Sampled, 1, 1),
                                                      effects = list(S_Index,
                                                                     i = Sampled$ID,
                                                                     effect_data))
                            
                            # Construct model formulae
                            covariate_formula <- paste(covariate_names, collapse = " + ")
                            
                            FormulaBase <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept + ", covariate_formula))
                            
                            FormulaI <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept + ", covariate_formula,
                                                          " + f(i, model = 'iid', ",
                                                          "hyper = list(prec = list(prior = 'pc.prec', param = c(3, 0.01))))"))
                            
                            FormulaV <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept",
                                                          " + f(i, model = 'iid', ",
                                                          "hyper = list(prec = list(prior = 'pc.prec', param = c(3, 0.01))))"))
                            
                            Formula <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept + ", covariate_formula,
                                                         " + f(s, model = SPDE)",
                                                         " + f(i, model = 'iid', ",
                                                         "hyper = list(prec = list(prior = 'pc.prec', param = c(3, 0.01))))"))
                            
                            FormulaS <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept", 
                                                         " + f(s, model = SPDE)",
                                                         " + f(i, model = 'iid', ",
                                                         "hyper = list(prec = list(prior = 'pc.prec', param = c(3, 0.01))))"))
                            
                            FormulaG <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept", 
                                                         " + f(s, model = SPDE)"))
                            
                            ModelConfigs <- list(ModelV = list(Formula = FormulaV, Stack = Stack, N_Covariates = 0, Covariates = "None"),
                                                 ModelBase = list(Formula = FormulaBase, Stack = Stack, N_Covariates = length(covariate_names), Covariates = paste(covariate_names, collapse = ", ")),
                                                 ModelI = list(Formula = FormulaI, Stack = Stack, N_Covariates = length(covariate_names), Covariates = paste(covariate_names, collapse = ", ")),
                                                 Model = list(Formula = Formula, Stack = Stack, N_Covariates = length(covariate_names), Covariates = paste(covariate_names, collapse = ", ")),
                                                 ModelS = list(Formula = FormulaS, Stack = Stack, N_Covariates = 0, Covariates = "None"),
                                                 ModelG = list(Formula = FormulaG, Stack = Stack, N_Covariates = 0, Covariates = "None"))
                            
                            Formulae <- list(FormulaV = FormulaV,
                                             FormulaBase = FormulaBase,
                                             FormulaI = FormulaI,
                                             Formula = Formula,
                                             FormulaS = FormulaS,
                                             FormulaG = FormulaG)
                            
                            # Model fit
                            fit_one_model <- function(model_config,
                                                      model_name) {message("Fitting ", model_name, " for ", dataset_name)
                                                                   this_formula <- model_config$Formula
                                                                   
                                                                   model_object <- INLA::inla(this_formula,
                                                                                              family = "binomial",
                                                                                              Ntrials = Sample,
                                                                                              inla.mode = "experimental",
                                                                                              data = INLA::inla.stack.data(Stack),
                                                                                              control.family = list(link = "logit"),
                                                                                              control.inla = list(int.strategy = "auto"),
                                                                                              control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE,
                                                                                                                       A = INLA::inla.stack.A(Stack),
                                                                                                                       link = 1),
                                                                                              control.compute = list(config = TRUE,
                                                                                                                     dic = TRUE,
                                                                                                                     waic = TRUE,
                                                                                                                     cpo = TRUE),
                                                                                              verbose = TRUE)
                                                                   
                                                                   sd_negative_log_cpo   <- sd(-log(model_object$cpo$cpo[is.finite(model_object$cpo$cpo) & model_object$cpo$cpo > 0]))
                                                                   se_negative_mean_log_cpo <- sd_negative_log_cpo / sqrt(length(-log(model_object$cpo$cpo[is.finite(model_object$cpo$cpo) & model_object$cpo$cpo > 0])))
                                                                   
                                                                   autoplot_object <- autoplot(model_object)
                                                                   sink(file.path(final_output_dir, paste0(model_name, "-summary.txt")))
                                                                   print(summary(model_object))
                                                                   print(model_object$summary.hyperpar)
                                                                   print(model_object$dic$dic)
                                                                   print(model_object$waic$waic)
                                                                   print(mean(log(model_object$cpo$cpo[model_object$cpo$cpo > 0]), na.rm = TRUE))
                                                                   print(sd_negative_log_cpo)
                                                                   print(se_negative_mean_log_cpo)
                                                                   sink()
                                                                   
                                                                   metrics <- tibble::tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                             Model = model_name,
                                                                                             N_Sampled = nrow(Data),
                                                                                             N_Unsampled = nrow(Unsampled),
                                                                                             N_Covariates = model_config$N_Covariates,
                                                                                             Covariates = model_config$Covariates,
                                                                                             DIC = model_object$dic$dic,
                                                                                             WAIC = model_object$waic$waic,
                                                                                             Mean_Log_CPO = mean(log(model_object$cpo$cpo[model_object$cpo$cpo > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                             Negative_Mean_Log_CPO = -mean(log(model_object$cpo$cpo[model_object$cpo$cpo > 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                             SD_Negative_Log_CPO = sd_negative_log_cpo,
                                                                                             SE_Negative_Mean_Log_CPO = se_negative_mean_log_cpo)
                                                                   
                                                                   list(ModelObject = model_object,
                                                                        Metrics = metrics,
                                                                        Autoplot = autoplot_object)}
                            
                            ModelFits <- purrr::imap(ModelConfigs, fit_one_model)
                            
                            calculate_residual_variogram <- function(Data, ModelV) {if (is.null(ModelV$summary.random$i)) {stop("ModelV does not contain summary.random$i. Check that ModelV includes f(i, model = 'iid').")}
                              
                                                                                    iid_summary <- ModelV$summary.random$i
                                                                                    id_col <- intersect(c("ID", "id", "idx"), names(iid_summary))[1]
                                                                                    
                                                                                    if (is.na(id_col)) {iid_summary$ID <- seq_len(nrow(iid_summary))
                                                                                                        id_col <- "ID"}
                                                                                    
                                                                                    residual_table <- tibble::tibble(ID = iid_summary[[id_col]],
                                                                                                                     residuals = iid_summary$mean)
                                                                                    
                                                                                    Data_resid <- Data %>%
                                                                                                  dplyr::mutate(ID = seq_len(dplyr::n())) %>%
                                                                                                  dplyr::left_join(residual_table, by = "ID") %>%
                                                                                                  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                                                                  dplyr::select(ID, residuals, longitude, latitude) %>%
                                                                                                  dplyr::filter(!is.na(residuals),
                                                                                                                !is.na(longitude),
                                                                                                                !is.na(latitude),
                                                                                                                is.finite(residuals),
                                                                                                                is.finite(longitude),
                                                                                                                is.finite(latitude))
                                                                                    
                                                                                    if (nrow(Data_resid) < 5) {stop("Too few valid ModelV residuals for residual variogram.")}
                                                                                    
                                                                                    sp::coordinates(Data_resid) <- ~ longitude + latitude
                                                                                    
                                                                                    vgm_resid <- gstat::variogram(residuals ~ 1, data = Data_resid)
                                                                                    
                                                                                    vgm_resid_fit <- tryCatch({gstat::fit.variogram(vgm_resid, gstat::vgm("Mat", fit.kappa = TRUE))},
                                                                                                              warning = function(w) {warning("ModelV residual variogram fit warning: ",
                                                                                                                                             conditionMessage(w))
                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                     suppressWarnings(gstat::fit.variogram(vgm_resid, gstat::vgm("Mat", fit.kappa = TRUE)))},
                                                                                                              error = function(e) {warning("ModelV residual variogram fit failed: ",
                                                                                                                                           conditionMessage(e))
                                                                                                                                    NULL})
                                                                                    
                                                                                    list(Data = Data_resid,
                                                                                         vgm_resid = vgm_resid,
                                                                                         vgm_resid_fit = vgm_resid_fit)}
                            ModelV <- ModelFits$ModelV$ModelObject
                            ModelV_residual_variogram <- calculate_residual_variogram(Data = Data, ModelV = ModelV)
                            ModelV_residual_variogram_summary <- tibble::tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                Model = "ModelV",
                                                                                Nugget = if (!is.null(ModelV_residual_variogram$vgm_resid_fit)) ModelV_residual_variogram$vgm_resid_fit$psill[1] else NA_real_,
                                                                                Partial_sill = if (!is.null(ModelV_residual_variogram$vgm_resid_fit)) ModelV_residual_variogram$vgm_resid_fit$psill[2] else NA_real_,
                                                                                Sill = if (!is.null(ModelV_residual_variogram$vgm_resid_fit)) sum(ModelV_residual_variogram$vgm_resid_fit$psill[1:2], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
                                                                                Range = if (!is.null(ModelV_residual_variogram$vgm_resid_fit)) ModelV_residual_variogram$vgm_resid_fit$range[2] else NA_real_,
                                                                                Kappa = if (!is.null(ModelV_residual_variogram$vgm_resid_fit) && "kappa" %in% names(ModelV_residual_variogram$vgm_resid_fit))ModelV_residual_variogram$vgm_resid_fit$kappa[2] else NA_real_)
                            
                            Evaluation_Metrics <- purrr::map_dfr(ModelFits, "Metrics")
                            
                            # Posterior simulation
                            Final_model_name <- "Model"
                            Model <- ModelFits[[Final_model_name]]$ModelObject
                            Posterior_Samples <- INLA::inla.posterior.sample(n = n_posterior, result = Model)
                            Posterior_Samples_contents <- Model$misc$configs$contents
                            
                            # Predictions
                            idIntercept <- Posterior_Samples_contents$start[Posterior_Samples_contents$tag == "Intercept"]
                            
                            model_covariates <- covariate_names[covariate_names %in% Posterior_Samples_contents$tag]
                            
                            if (length(model_covariates) > 0) {covariate_indices <- sapply(model_covariates, function(v) {Posterior_Samples_contents$start[Posterior_Samples_contents$tag == v]})
                                                               all_indices <- c(idIntercept, covariate_indices)
                                                               
                                                               cov_matrix <- as.matrix(Unsampled[, model_covariates, drop = FALSE])}
                            else {covariate_indices <- integer(0)
                                  all_indices <- idIntercept
                                  cov_matrix <- NULL}
                            
                            idSpace <- Posterior_Samples_contents$start[Posterior_Samples_contents$tag == "s"] +
                                       seq_len(Posterior_Samples_contents$length[Posterior_Samples_contents$tag == "s"]) - 1
                            
                            xHyper <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(Posterior_Samples[[1]]$hyperpar), ncol = length(Posterior_Samples))
                            for (i in seq_along(Posterior_Samples)) {xHyper[, i] <- Posterior_Samples[[i]]$hyperpar}
                            
                            sample.IIDpred <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(Unsampled), ncol = length(Posterior_Samples))
                            for (i in seq_along(Posterior_Samples)) {sd_i <- xHyper[nrow(xHyper), i]^(-0.5)
                                                                     sample.IIDpred[, i] <- rnorm(nrow(Unsampled), mean = 0, sd = sd_i)}
                            
                            Predictions <- matrix(NA_real_,
                                                  nrow = nrow(Unsampled),
                                                  ncol = length(Posterior_Samples))
                            
                            cov_matrix <- as.matrix(Unsampled[, covariate_names, drop = FALSE])
                            
                            for (i in seq_along(Posterior_Samples)) {spatial_sample <- as.vector(A_Unsampled %*% Posterior_Samples[[i]]$latent[idSpace])
                                                                     beta <- Posterior_Samples[[i]]$latent[all_indices]
                                                                     covariate_term <- if (length(model_covariates) > 0) {as.vector(cov_matrix %*% beta[-1])} 
                                                                                       else {rep(0, nrow(Unsampled))}
                                                                     eta <- spatial_sample +
                                                                            sample.IIDpred[, i] +
                                                                            covariate_term +
                                                                            beta[1]
                                                                     
                                                                     Predictions[, i] <- plogis(eta)}
                            
                            Results <- t(apply(Predictions, 1, function(x) {c(mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                              sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                              `0.25quant` = quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                              `0.025quant` = quantile(x, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                              `0.5quant` = quantile(x, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                              `0.75quant` = quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                              `0.975quant` = quantile(x, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))}))
                            
                            Results <- as.data.frame(Results)
                            Results <- Results * 100
                            
                            # Raster outputs and leaflet maps
                            PredictionMean <- terra::rasterize(sf::st_as_sf(as.data.frame(cbind(Mean = Results$mean,
                                                                                                X = Unsampled$X,
                                                                                                Y = Unsampled$Y)),
                                                                            coords = c("X", "Y"),
                                                                            crs = 4326),
                                                               terra::rast(Raster),
                                                               field = "Mean",
                                                               touches = TRUE)
                            
                            Prediction95CI <- terra::rasterize(sf::st_as_sf(as.data.frame(cbind(CI95 = Results$`0.975quant` - Results$`0.025quant`,
                                                                                                X = Unsampled$X,
                                                                                                Y = Unsampled$Y)),
                                                                            coords = c("X", "Y"),
                                                                            crs = 4326),
                                                               terra::rast(Raster),
                                                               field = "CI95",
                                                               touches = TRUE)
                            
                            PredictionU <- terra::rasterize(sf::st_as_sf(as.data.frame(cbind(U = Results$`0.75quant`,
                                                                                             X = Unsampled$X,
                                                                                             Y = Unsampled$Y)),
                                                                         coords = c("X", "Y"),
                                                                         crs = 4326),
                                                            terra::rast(Raster),
                                                            field = "U",
                                                            touches = TRUE)
                            
                            PredictionL <- terra::rasterize(sf::st_as_sf(as.data.frame(cbind(L = Results$`0.25quant`,
                                                                                             X = Unsampled$X,
                                                                                             Y = Unsampled$Y)),
                                                                         coords = c("X", "Y"),
                                                                         crs = 4326),
                                                            terra::rast(Raster),
                                                            field = "L",
                                                            touches = TRUE)
                            
                            PredictionSD <- terra::rasterize(sf::st_as_sf(as.data.frame(cbind(SD = Results$sd,
                                                                                              X = Unsampled$X,
                                                                                              Y = Unsampled$Y)),
                                                                          coords = c("X", "Y"),
                                                                          crs = 4326),
                                                             terra::rast(Raster),
                                                             field = "SD",
                                                             touches = TRUE)
                            
                            Prediction95CI_Pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric(reverse = TRUE,
                                                                        na.color = "transparent",
                                                                        palette = viridis::viridis_pal(option = "G", end = 0.9)(10),
                                                                        domain = c(min(terra::values(Prediction95CI), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                   max(terra::values(Prediction95CI), na.rm = TRUE)))
                            
                            PredictionMean_Pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric(reverse = TRUE,
                                                                        na.color = "transparent",
                                                                        palette = viridis::viridis_pal(option = "F", end = 0.9)(10),
                                                                        domain = c(min(terra::values(PredictionMean), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                   max(terra::values(PredictionMean), na.rm = TRUE)))
                            
                            PredictionU_Pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric(reverse = TRUE,
                                                                     na.color = "transparent",
                                                                     palette = viridis::viridis_pal(option = "F", end = 0.9)(10),
                                                                     domain = c(min(terra::values(PredictionU), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                max(terra::values(PredictionU), na.rm = TRUE)))
                            
                            PredictionL_Pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric(reverse = TRUE,
                                                                     na.color = "transparent",
                                                                     palette = viridis::viridis_pal(option = "F", end = 0.9)(10),
                                                                     domain = c(min(terra::values(PredictionL), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                max(terra::values(PredictionL), na.rm = TRUE)))
                            
                            PredictionSD_Pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric(reverse = TRUE,
                                                                      na.color = "transparent",
                                                                      palette = viridis::viridis_pal(option = "G", end = 0.9)(10),
                                                                      domain = c(min(terra::values(PredictionSD), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                 max(terra::values(PredictionSD), na.rm = TRUE)))
                            
                            # Prediction maps: horizontal legends with and without text
                            title_prediction_mean <- legend_titles$prediction_mean
                            title_ci95 <- legend_titles$ci95
                            title_sd <- legend_titles$sd
                            title_l <- legend_titles$l
                            title_u <- legend_titles$u
                            title_burden <- legend_titles$burden
                            title_burden_l <- legend_titles$burden_l
                            title_burden_u <- legend_titles$burden_u
                            
                            Mean <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = PredictionMean,
                                                            pal = PredictionMean_Pal,
                                                            domain = Domain,
                                                            title = title_prediction_mean,
                                                            show_text = TRUE,
                                                            comma_labels = FALSE,
                                                            accuracy = 0.01)
                            
                            Mean2 <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = PredictionMean,
                                                             pal = PredictionMean_Pal,
                                                             domain = Domain,
                                                             title = title_prediction_mean,
                                                             show_text = FALSE,
                                                             comma_labels = FALSE,
                                                             accuracy = 0.01)
                            
                            CI95 <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = Prediction95CI,
                                                            pal = Prediction95CI_Pal,
                                                            domain = Domain,
                                                            title = title_ci95,
                                                            show_text = TRUE,
                                                            comma_labels = FALSE,
                                                            accuracy = 0.01)
                            
                            CI952 <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = Prediction95CI,
                                                             pal = Prediction95CI_Pal,
                                                             domain = Domain,
                                                             title = title_ci95,
                                                             show_text = FALSE,
                                                             comma_labels = FALSE,
                                                             accuracy = 0.01)
                            
                            U <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = PredictionU,
                                                         pal = PredictionU_Pal,
                                                         domain = Domain,
                                                         title = title_u,
                                                         show_text = TRUE,
                                                         comma_labels = FALSE,
                                                         accuracy = 0.01)
                            
                            U2 <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = PredictionU,
                                                          pal = PredictionU_Pal,
                                                          domain = Domain,
                                                          title = title_u,
                                                          show_text = FALSE,
                                                          comma_labels = FALSE,
                                                          accuracy = 0.01)
                            
                            L <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = PredictionL,
                                                         pal = PredictionL_Pal,
                                                         domain = Domain,
                                                         title = title_l,
                                                         show_text = TRUE,
                                                         comma_labels = FALSE,
                                                         accuracy = 0.01)
                            
                            L2 <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = PredictionL,
                                                          pal = PredictionL_Pal,
                                                          domain = Domain,
                                                          title = title_l,
                                                          show_text = FALSE,
                                                          comma_labels = FALSE,
                                                          accuracy = 0.01)
                            
                            SD <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = PredictionSD,
                                                          pal = PredictionSD_Pal,
                                                          domain = Domain,
                                                          title = title_sd,
                                                          show_text = TRUE,
                                                          comma_labels = FALSE,
                                                          accuracy = 0.01)
                            
                            SD2 <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = PredictionSD,
                                                           pal = PredictionSD_Pal,
                                                           domain = Domain,
                                                           title = title_sd,
                                                           show_text = FALSE,
                                                           comma_labels = FALSE,
                                                           accuracy = 0.01)
                            
                            # Burden rasters and maps
                            Population <- terra::crop(terra::rast(Population), terra::ext(PredictionMean))
                            Population <- terra::resample(Population, PredictionMean, method = "sum")
                            Burden <- PredictionMean * Population / 100
                            Burden[] <- round(Burden[])
                            burden_values <- terra::values(Burden)
                            burden_values <- burden_values[is.finite(burden_values)]
                            
                            breaks <- round(classInt::classIntervals(burden_values,
                                                                     n = 8,
                                                                     style = "fisher")$brks)
                            
                            Burden_Pal <- leaflet::colorBin(palette = viridis::viridis_pal(option = "F", end = 0.9)(length(breaks) - 1),
                                                            domain = c(min(terra::values(Burden), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                       max(terra::values(Burden), na.rm = TRUE)),
                                                            bins = breaks,
                                                            na.color = "transparent",
                                                            reverse = TRUE)
                            
                            PopB <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = Burden,
                                                            pal = Burden_Pal,
                                                            domain = Domain,
                                                            title = title_burden,
                                                            show_text = TRUE,
                                                            comma_labels = TRUE,
                                                            accuracy = 1)
                            
                            PopB2 <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = Burden,
                                                             pal = Burden_Pal,
                                                             domain = Domain,
                                                             title = title_burden,
                                                             show_text = FALSE,
                                                             comma_labels = TRUE,
                                                             accuracy = 1)
                            
                            BurdenL <- PredictionL * Population / 100
                            BurdenL[] <- round(BurdenL[])
                            burdenL_values <- terra::values(BurdenL)
                            burdenL_values <- burdenL_values[is.finite(burdenL_values)]
                            
                            breaksL <- round(classInt::classIntervals(burdenL_values,
                                                                      n = 8,
                                                                      style = "fisher")$brks)
                            
                            BurdenL_Pal <- leaflet::colorBin(palette = viridis::viridis_pal(option = "F", end = 0.9)(length(breaksL) - 1),
                                                             domain = c(min(terra::values(BurdenL), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                        max(terra::values(BurdenL), na.rm = TRUE)),
                                                             bins = breaksL,
                                                             na.color = "transparent",
                                                             reverse = TRUE)
                            
                            PopBL <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = BurdenL,
                                                             pal = BurdenL_Pal,
                                                             domain = Domain,
                                                             title = title_burden_l,
                                                             show_text = TRUE,
                                                             comma_labels = TRUE,
                                                             accuracy = 1)
                            
                            PopBL2 <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = BurdenL,
                                                              pal = BurdenL_Pal,
                                                              domain = Domain,
                                                              title = title_burden_l,
                                                              show_text = FALSE,
                                                              comma_labels = TRUE,
                                                              accuracy = 1)
                            
                            BurdenU <- PredictionU * Population / 100
                            BurdenU[] <- round(BurdenU[])
                            burdenU_values <- terra::values(BurdenU)
                            burdenU_values <- burdenU_values[is.finite(burdenU_values)]
                            
                            breaksU <- round(classInt::classIntervals(burdenU_values,
                                                                      n = 8,
                                                                      style = "fisher")$brks)
                            
                            BurdenU_Pal <- leaflet::colorBin(palette = viridis::viridis_pal(option = "F", end = 0.9)(length(breaksU) - 1),
                                                             domain = c(min(terra::values(BurdenU), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                        max(terra::values(BurdenU), na.rm = TRUE)),
                                                             bins = breaksU,
                                                             na.color = "transparent",
                                                             reverse = TRUE)
                            
                            PopBU <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = BurdenU,
                                                             pal = BurdenU_Pal,
                                                             domain = Domain,
                                                             title = title_burden_u,
                                                             show_text = TRUE,
                                                             comma_labels = TRUE,
                                                             accuracy = 1)
                            
                            PopBU2 <- make_raster_leaflet_map(raster_layer = BurdenU,
                                                              pal = BurdenU_Pal,
                                                              domain = Domain,
                                                              title = title_burden_u,
                                                              show_text = FALSE,
                                                              comma_labels = TRUE,
                                                              accuracy = 1)
                            
                            return(list(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                        Formulae = Formulae,
                                        ModelConfigs = ModelConfigs,
                                        Mesh = Mesh,
                                        SPDE = SPDE,
                                        S_Index = S_Index,
                                        A_Sampled = A_Sampled,
                                        A_Unsampled = A_Unsampled,
                                        Sampled = Sampled,
                                        Unsampled = Unsampled,
                                        ModelFits = ModelFits,
                                        ModelV = ModelFits$ModelV$ModelObject,
                                        ModelBase = ModelFits$ModelBase$ModelObject,
                                        ModelI = ModelFits$ModelI$ModelObject,
                                        Model = ModelFits$Model$ModelObject,
                                        ModelS = ModelFits$ModelS$ModelObject,
                                        ModelG = ModelFits$ModelG$ModelObject,
                                        Model_autoplots = purrr::map(ModelFits, "Autoplot"),
                                        Evaluation_Metrics = Evaluation_Metrics,
                                        Posterior_Samples = Posterior_Samples,
                                        Posterior_Samples_contents = Posterior_Samples_contents,
                                        Predictions = Predictions,
                                        Results = Results,
                                        PredictionMean = PredictionMean,
                                        Prediction95CI = Prediction95CI,
                                        PredictionU = PredictionU,
                                        PredictionL = PredictionL,
                                        PredictionSD = PredictionSD,
                                        Burden = Burden,
                                        BurdenL = BurdenL,
                                        BurdenU = BurdenU,
                                        Mean_map = Mean,
                                        U_map = U,
                                        L_map = L,
                                        SD_map = SD,
                                        CI95_map = CI95,
                                        Mean_map2 = Mean2,
                                        U_map2 = U2,

export_inla_autoplot_separate <- function(plot_object,
                                          model_name,
                                          output_dir = autoplot_dir,
                                          theme_object = journal_theme_text,
                                          suffix = "with_text",
                                          width_mm = 120,
                                          height_mm = 120,
                                          dpi = 300) {if (is.null(plot_object)) {warning("No autoplot object found for ", model_name)
                                                                                 return(invisible(NULL))}
  
                                                      if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)}
  
                                                      clean_model_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", model_name)
                                                      clean_suffix <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", suffix)
                                                      
                                                      save_one <- function(p, filename) {ggplot2::ggsave(filename = filename,
                                                                                                         plot = p + theme_object,
                                                                                                         width = width_mm,
                                                                                                         height = height_mm,
                                                                                                         units = "mm",
                                                                                                         dpi = dpi,
                                                                                                         device = "tiff",
                                                                                                         compression = "lzw",
                                                                                                         bg = "white",
                                                                                                         limitsize = FALSE)
                                                        
                                                                                          invisible(filename)}
                                                      
                                                      if (inherits(plot_object, "list")) {plot_list <- plot_object[vapply(plot_object, function(x) inherits(x, "ggplot"), logical(1))]
                                                      
                                                                                          if (length(plot_list) == 0) {warning("No ggplot objects found inside autoplot object for ", model_name)
                                                                                                                       return(invisible(NULL))}
                                                      
                                                                                          output_files <- character(length(plot_list))
                                                                                          
                                                                                          for (i in seq_along(plot_list)) {output_files[i] <- file.path(output_dir,
                                                                                                                                                        paste0(clean_model_name, "_autoplot_", i, "_", clean_suffix, ".tiff"))
                                                                                          
                                                                                                                           save_one(plot_list[[i]], output_files[i])}
                                                                                          
                                                                                          return(invisible(output_files))}
                                                      
                                                      if (!inherits(plot_object, "ggplot")) {warning("Autoplot object for ", model_name, " is not a ggplot object.")
                                                                                             return(invisible(NULL))}
                                                      
                                                      output_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(clean_model_name, "_autoplot_", clean_suffix, ".tiff"))
                                                      
                                                      save_one(plot_object, output_file)
                                                      
                                                      invisible(output_file)}
