```{r predictions export}
open_theme_tiff <- function(filename,
                            width = 200,
                            height = 150,
                            units = "mm",
                            res = 300,
                            pointsize = 10) {grDevices::tiff(filename = filename,
                                                             width = width,
                                                             height = height,
                                                             units = units,
                                                             res = res,
                                                             pointsize = pointsize,
                                                             compression = "lzw",
                                                             bg = "white",
                                                             family = "Times New Roman")
  
                                             graphics::par(family = "Times New Roman",
                                                           ps = 10,    
                                                           cex = 1,
                                                           cex.main = 1,
                                                           cex.lab = 1,
                                                           cex.axis = 1,
                                                           cex.sub = 1)}

plot_residual_variogram_pair <- function(vgm_resid,
                                         vgm_resid_fit,
                                         output_dir,
                                         prefix = "ModelV_residual_variogram") {if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)}
  
                                                                                draw_variogram_base <- function(with_text = TRUE) {plot(vgm_resid$dist,
                                                                                                                                        vgm_resid$gamma,
                                                                                                                                        pch = 16,
                                                                                                                                        col = "black",
                                                                                                                                        xlab = if (with_text) "Distance between locations" else "",
                                                                                                                                        ylab = if (with_text) "Residual semivariance" else "",
                                                                                                                                        main = "",
                                                                                                                                        axes = with_text)
                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                   if (!with_text) {graphics::axis(1, labels = FALSE)
                                                                                                                                                    graphics::axis(2, labels = FALSE)
                                                                                                                                                    graphics::box()}
                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                   if (!is.null(vgm_resid_fit)) {model_line <- tryCatch({gstat::variogramLine(vgm_resid_fit,
                                                                                                                                                                                                              maxdist = max(vgm_resid$dist, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            na.rm = TRUE))},
                                                                                                                                                                                        error = function(e) NULL)
                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                 if (!is.null(model_line)) {graphics::lines(model_line$dist,
                                                                                                                                                                                                            model_line$gamma,
                                                                                                                                                                                                            lwd = 1)}}}
                                                                                open_theme_tiff(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_with_text.tiff")))
                                                                                
                                                                                tryCatch(draw_variogram_base(with_text = TRUE),
                                                                                         finally = grDevices::dev.off())
                                                                                
                                                                                open_theme_tiff(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_no_text.tiff")))
                                                                                
                                                                                tryCatch(draw_variogram_base(with_text = FALSE),
                                                                                         finally = grDevices::dev.off())
                                                                                
                                                                                invisible(TRUE)}

plot_parameter_guides_pair <- function(vgm_resid,
                                       vgm_resid_fit,
                                       output_dir,
                                       prefix = "ModelV_residual_variogram_parameter_guides") {draw_parameter_guides <- function(with_text = TRUE) {plot(vgm_resid$dist,
                                                                                                                                                         vgm_resid$gamma,
                                                                                                                                                         ylim = c(0, max(vgm_resid$gamma, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                                                                                                                                         col = "black",
                                                                                                                                                         pch = 16,
                                                                                                                                                         xlab = if (with_text) "Distance between locations" else "",
                                                                                                                                                         ylab = if (with_text) "Residual semivariance" else "",
                                                                                                                                                         main = "",
                                                                                                                                                         xaxt = if (with_text) "s" else "n",
                                                                                                                                                         yaxt = if (with_text) "s" else "n")
                                         
                                                                                                                                                    if (!with_text) {graphics::axis(1, labels = FALSE)
                                                                                                                                                                     graphics::axis(2, labels = FALSE)
                                                                                                                                                                     graphics::box()}
                                         
                                                                                                                                                    if (!is.null(vgm_resid_fit)) {model_line <- tryCatch({gstat::variogramLine(gstat::vgm(psill = vgm_resid_fit$psill[2],
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          model = "Mat",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          range = vgm_resid_fit$range[2],
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kappa = vgm_resid_fit$kappa[2],
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          nugget = vgm_resid_fit$psill[1]),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               maxdist = max(vgm_resid$dist, na.rm = TRUE))},
                                                                                                                                                                                                         error = function(e) NULL)
                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                    if (!is.null(model_line)) {lines(model_line$dist, model_line$gamma, type = "l")}
                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                    abline(h = vgm_resid_fit$psill[1], col = "#4d43a9")
                                                                                                                                                    abline(v = vgm_resid_fit$range[2], col = "#BE1D54")
                                                                                                                                                    abline(h = vgm_resid_fit$psill[1] + vgm_resid_fit$psill[2], col = "#439fa9")
                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                    if (with_text) {legend("bottomright",
                                                                                                                                                                           legend = c("Nugget", "Range", "Sill"),
                                                                                                                                                                           col = c("#4d43a9", "#BE1D54", "#439fa9"),
                                                                                                                                                                           lty = 1,
                                                                                                                                                                           bty = "n",
                                                                                                                                                                           cex = 1)}}}
                                       
                                       open_theme_tiff(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_with_text.tiff")))
                                       draw_parameter_guides(with_text = TRUE)
                                       grDevices::dev.off()
                                       
                                       open_theme_tiff(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_no_text.tiff")))
                                       draw_parameter_guides(with_text = FALSE)
                                       grDevices::dev.off()}

plot_randomized_variogram_pair <- function(Data_resid,
                                           output_dir,
                                           prefix = "ModelV_randomized_residual_variogram",
                                           seed = 123) {set.seed(seed)
  
                                                        if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)}
  
                                                        Data_rand <- Data_resid
                                                        Data_rand$residuals_rand <- sample(Data_rand$residuals,
                                                                                           nrow(Data_rand),
                                                                                           replace = FALSE)
                                                        
                                                        vgm_rand <- gstat::variogram(residuals_rand ~ 1, data = Data_rand)
                                                        draw_randomized_variogram_base <- function(with_text = TRUE) {plot(vgm_rand$dist,
                                                                                                                           vgm_rand$gamma,
                                                                                                                           pch = 16,
                                                                                                                           col = "black",
                                                                                                                           xlab = if (with_text) "Distance between locations" else "",
                                                                                                                           ylab = if (with_text) "Residual semivariance" else "",
                                                                                                                           main = "",
                                                                                                                           axes = with_text)
                                                          
                                                                                                                       if (!with_text) {graphics::axis(1, labels = FALSE)
                                                                                                                                        graphics::axis(2, labels = FALSE)
                                                                                                                                        graphics::box()}}
                                                        
                                                        open_theme_tiff(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_with_text.tiff")))
                                                        
                                                        tryCatch(draw_randomized_variogram_base(with_text = TRUE),
                                                                 finally = grDevices::dev.off())
                                                        
                                                        open_theme_tiff(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_no_text.tiff")))
                                                        
                                                        tryCatch(draw_randomized_variogram_base(with_text = FALSE),
                                                                 finally = grDevices::dev.off())
                                                        
                                                        invisible(vgm_rand)}

modelv_plot_dir <- file.path("Output/", "Final", "Variogram")

if (!dir.exists(modelv_plot_dir)) {dir.create(modelv_plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)}
```

```{r validation model}
CrossValidate_INLA_Dataset8 <- function(Data,

                                        n_posterior = 1000,
                                        verbose = TRUE,
                                        export = TRUE) {dataset_output_dir <- file.path(output_root, dataset_name, "CrossValidation")
                                                        
                                                        if (!dir.exists(dataset_output_dir)) {dir.create(dataset_output_dir, recursive = TRUE)}
                                                        if (!inherits(Data, "sf")) {Data <- sf::st_as_sf(Data, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)}
                                                        
                                                        required_columns <- c("Cluster", "total", "count", "value", "longitude", "latitude", "geo_admin0")
                                                        missing_required <- setdiff(required_columns, names(Data))
                                                        
                                                        if (length(missing_required) > 0) {stop("Dataset ", dataset_name, " is missing required column(s): ", paste(missing_required, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)}
                                                        
                                                        if (is.null(covariate_names)) {non_covariate_columns <- c("ADM0", "geo_admin0", "ADM1", "geo_admin1", "ADM2", "geo_admin2", 
                                                                                                                  "Cluster", "total", "count", "value", "longitude", "latitude", "geometry", "Fold")
                                                        
                                                                                       covariate_names <- setdiff(names(Data), non_covariate_columns)
                                                                                       covariate_names <- setdiff(covariate_names, attr(Data, "sf_column"))
                                                                                       covariate_names <- covariate_names[covariate_names %in% names(Data)]}
                                                        
                                                        if (length(covariate_names) == 0) {stop("No covariates supplied or detected in ", dataset_name, ".", call. = FALSE)}
                                                        missing_covariates <- setdiff(covariate_names, names(Data))
                                                        
                                                        if (length(missing_covariates) > 0) {stop("Dataset ", dataset_name, " is missing covariate(s): ", paste(missing_covariates, collapse = ", "),  call. = FALSE)}
                                                        
                                                        message("Using existing Cluster column.")
                                                        message("Using covariates: ", paste(covariate_names, collapse = ", "))
                                                        
                                                        # Helper functions
                                                        lonlat3D <- function(lon, lat) {cbind(cos((lon / 180) * pi) * cos((lat / 180) * pi),
                                                                                              sin((lon / 180) * pi) * cos((lat / 180) * pi),
                                                                                              sin((lat / 180) * pi))}
                                                        
                                                        make_INLA_boundary <- function(Data,
                                                                                       ADM0_path,
                                                                                       adm0_data_col = "geo_admin0",
                                                                                       adm0_boundary_col = "geo_admin0") {ADM0 <- sf::st_read(ADM0_path, quiet = TRUE)
                                                                                       
                                                                                                                          if (!adm0_data_col %in% names(Data)) {stop("Column ", adm0_data_col, " not found in dataset.", call. = FALSE)}
                                                                                                                          if (!adm0_boundary_col %in% names(ADM0)) {stop("Column ", adm0_boundary_col, " not found in ADM0 boundary file. Available columns are: ",
                                                                                                                                                                         paste(names(ADM0), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)}
                                                                                       
                                                                                       dataset_adm0 <- Data %>%
                                                                                                       sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                                                                       dplyr::pull(.data[[adm0_data_col]]) %>%
                                                                                                       unique()
                                                                                       
                                                                                       ADM0 <- ADM0 %>%
                                                                                               dplyr::filter(.data[[adm0_boundary_col]] %in% dataset_adm0)
                                                                                       
                                                                                       if (nrow(ADM0) == 0) {stop("No matching ADM0 boundaries found. Check that ", adm0_data_col, " in the dataset matches ", adm0_boundary_col, " in ADM0.gpkg.", call. = FALSE)}
                                                                                       
                                                                                       Boundary <- ADM0 %>%
                                                                                                   sf::st_combine() %>%
                                                                                                   sf::st_cast("MULTILINESTRING") %>%
                                                                                                   sf::st_cast("LINESTRING")
                                                                                       
                                                                                       Segments <- lapply(sf::st_geometry(Boundary),
                                                                                                          function(line) {coords <- sf::st_coordinates(line)
                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                          INLA::inla.mesh.segment(loc = lonlat3D(coords[, 1], coords[, 2]), is.bnd = TRUE)})
                                                                                       
                                                                                       Boundary_loc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Segments, function(x) x$loc))
                                                                                       
                                                                                       Indexing <- list()
                                                                                       Offset <- 0
                                                                                       
                                                                                       for (s in Segments) {Indexing[[length(Indexing) + 1]] <- matrix(s$idx + Offset, ncol = ncol(s$idx))
                                                                                                            Offset <- Offset + nrow(s$loc)}
                                                                                       
                                                                                       Indexing <- do.call(rbind, Indexing)
                                                                                       
                                                                                       Boundary <- INLA::inla.mesh.segment(loc = Boundary_loc, idx = Indexing, is.bnd = TRUE)
                                                                                       Boundary$idx <- Boundary$idx[, 2:1]
                                                                                       
                                                                                       list(ADM0 = ADM0, Boundary = Boundary)}
                                                        
                                                        get_r0 <- function(ADM0) {ee <- raster::extent(ADM0)
                                                                                  true.radius.of.earth <- 6371
                                                                                  
                                                                                  as.numeric(0.05 * fields::rdist.earth(matrix(c(ee[1], ee[3]), ncol = 2),
                                                                                                                        matrix(c(ee[2], ee[4]), ncol = 2),
                                                                                                                        miles = FALSE,
                                                                                                                        R = true.radius.of.earth))}
                                                        
                                                        get_latent_index <- function(model, tag) {contents <- model$misc$configs$contents
                                                        
                                                                                                  if (!tag %in% contents$tag) {return(NA_integer_)}
                                                        
                                                                                                  contents$start[contents$tag == tag]}
                                                        
                                                        get_spatial_indices <- function(model) {contents <- model$misc$configs$contents
                                                        
                                                                                                if (!"s" %in% contents$tag) {return(NULL)}
                                                        
                                                                                                start <- contents$start[contents$tag == "s"]
                                                                                                length <- contents$length[contents$tag == "s"]
                                                                                                
                                                                                                start + seq_len(length) - 1}
                                                        
                                                        bt <- function(x) {paste0("`", x, "`")}
                                                        
                                                        # Fold partition
                                                        set.seed(seed)
                                                        
                                                        Data$Fold <- NA_integer_
                                                        eligible_clusters <- unique(Data$Cluster)
                                                        eligible_clusters <- eligible_clusters[!is.na(eligible_clusters) & eligible_clusters != 0]
                                                        
                                                        for (cl in eligible_clusters) {idx <- which(Data$Cluster == cl)
                                                                                       n <- length(idx)
                                                                                       
                                                                                       if (n >= 10) {Data$Fold[idx] <- sample(rep(seq_len(K), length.out = n))}}
                                                        
                                                        if (any(Data$Cluster == 0 & !is.na(Data$Fold), na.rm = TRUE)) {stop("Cluster 0 has been assigned to a test fold. Check fold-generation logic.", call. = FALSE)}
                                                        
                                                        fold_table <- Data %>%
                                                                      sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                                      dplyr::count(Cluster, Fold, name = "n") %>%
                                                                      dplyr::arrange(Cluster, Fold)
                                                        
                                                        message("Rows assigned to test folds: ", sum(!is.na(Data$Fold)))
                                                        message("Rows always retained in training: ", sum(is.na(Data$Fold)))
                                                        
                                                        # Dataset-specific ADM0 boundary
                                                        boundary_obj <- make_INLA_boundary(Data = Data,
                                                                                           ADM0_path = ADM0_path,
                                                                                           adm0_data_col = "geo_admin0",
                                                                                           adm0_boundary_col = "geo_admin0")
                                                        
                                                        ADM0 <- boundary_obj$ADM0
                                                        Boundary <- boundary_obj$Boundary
                                                        true.radius.of.earth <- 6371
                                                        r0 <- get_r0(ADM0)
                                                        
                                                        # Storage
                                                        FoldEvaluationResults <- list()
                                                        FoldPredictionResults <- list()
                                                        
                                                        # Cross-validation folds
                                                        for (fold_i in seq_len(K)) {message("------------------------------------------------------------")
                                                                                    message("Dataset ", dataset_name, " | Fold ", fold_i)
                                                                                    message("------------------------------------------------------------")
                                                                                    
                                                                                    Test_Prev <- Data[!is.na(Data$Fold) & Data$Fold == fold_i,]
                                                                                    Train_Prev <- Data[is.na(Data$Fold) | Data$Fold != fold_i, ]
                                                                                    
                                                                                    if (nrow(Test_Prev) == 0) {warning("Skipping ", dataset_name, " fold ", fold_i, ": no test rows.")
                                                                                                               next}
                                                                                    
                                                                                    message("Training rows: ", nrow(Train_Prev))
                                                                                    message("Testing rows: ", nrow(Test_Prev))
                                                                                    
                                                                                    # Sampled/test coordinate objects
                                                                                    Sampled <- cbind(as.data.frame(sf::st_coordinates(Train_Prev)),
                                                                                                     sf::st_drop_geometry(Train_Prev)[, covariate_names, drop = FALSE])
                                                                                    
                                                                                    Unsampled <- cbind(as.data.frame(sf::st_coordinates(Test_Prev)),
                                                                                                       sf::st_drop_geometry(Test_Prev)[, covariate_names, drop = FALSE])
                                                                                    
                                                                                    Sampled$ID <- seq_len(nrow(Sampled))
                                                                                    Unsampled$ID <- seq(from = nrow(Sampled) + 1, length.out = nrow(Unsampled))
                                                                                    
                                                                                    # Fold-specific mesh, SPDE, projection matrices
                                                                                    Mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(loc = lonlat3D(Sampled[, 1], Sampled[, 2]),
                                                                                                         boundary = Boundary,    
                                                                                                         cutoff = 50 / true.radius.of.earth,
                                                                                                         offset = c(500, 1000) / true.radius.of.earth,
                                                                                                         max.edge = c(100, 1000) / true.radius.of.earth)
                                                                                    
                                                                                    A_Sampled <- INLA::inla.spde.make.A(mesh = Mesh,
                                                                                                                        loc = lonlat3D(Sampled[, 1], Sampled[, 2]))
                                                                                    
                                                                                    A_Unsampled <- INLA::inla.spde.make.A(mesh = Mesh,
                                                                                                                          loc = lonlat3D(Unsampled[, 1], Unsampled[, 2]))
                                                                                    
                                                                                    SPDE <- INLA::inla.spde2.pcmatern(mesh = Mesh,
                                                                                                                      alpha = 2,
                                                                                                                      prior.range = c(r0 / true.radius.of.earth, 0.01),
                                                                                                                      prior.sigma = c(3, 0.01))
                                                                                    
                                                                                    S_Index <- INLA::inla.spde.make.index(name = "s",
                                                                                                                          n.spde = SPDE$n.spde)
                                                                                    
                                                                                    # One stack per fold, reused across all formulae
                                                                                    effect_data <- Sampled[, covariate_names, drop = FALSE]
                                                                                    
                                                                                    Stack_Sampled <- INLA::inla.stack(tag = "point",
                                                                                                                      data = list(y = Train_Prev$count,
                                                                                                                                  Sample = Train_Prev$total),
                                                                                                                      A = list(A_Sampled, 1, 1),
                                                                                                                      effects = list(S_Index,
                                                                                                                                     i = Sampled$ID,
                                                                                                                                     data.frame(Intercept = 1,
                                                                                                                                                effect_data,
                                                                                                                                                check.names = FALSE)))
                                                                                    Stack <- INLA::inla.stack(Stack_Sampled)
                                                                                    
                                                                                    # Formulae
                                                                                    covariate_formula <- paste(bt(covariate_names), collapse = " + ")
                                                                                    
                                                                                    FormulaV <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept", " + f(i, model = 'iid', ", "hyper = list(prec = list(prior = 'pc.prec', param = c(3, 0.01))))"))
                                                                                    FormulaBase <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept + ", covariate_formula))
                                                                                    FormulaI <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept + ", covariate_formula, " + f(i, model = 'iid', ", "hyper = list(prec = list(prior = 'pc.prec', param = c(3, 0.01))))"))
                                                                                    Formula <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept + ", covariate_formula, " + f(s, model = SPDE)", " + f(i, model = 'iid', ", 
                                                                                                                 "hyper = list(prec = list(prior = 'pc.prec', param = c(3, 0.01))))"))
                                                                                    FormulaS <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept", " + f(s, model = SPDE)", " + f(i, model = 'iid', ", 
                                                                                                                  "hyper = list(prec = list(prior = 'pc.prec', param = c(3, 0.01))))"))
                                                                                    FormulaG <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + Intercept", " + f(s, model = SPDE)"))
                                                                                    
                                                                                    ModelConfigs <- list(ModelV = list(Formula = FormulaV,
                                                                                                                       N_Covariates = 0,
                                                                                                                       Covariates = "None"),
                                                                                                         ModelBase = list(Formula = FormulaBase,
                                                                                                                          N_Covariates = length(covariate_names),
                                                                                                                          Covariates = paste(covariate_names, collapse = ", ")),
                                                                                                         ModelI = list(Formula = FormulaI,
                                                                                                                       N_Covariates = length(covariate_names),
                                                                                                                       Covariates = paste(covariate_names, collapse = ", ")),
                                                                                                         Model = list(Formula = Formula,
                                                                                                                      N_Covariates = length(covariate_names),
                                                                                                                      Covariates = paste(covariate_names, collapse = ", ")),
                                                                                                         ModelS = list(Formula = FormulaS,
                                                                                                                       N_Covariates = 0,
                                                                                                                       Covariates = "None"),
                                                                                                         ModelG = list(Formula = FormulaG,
                                                                                                                       N_Covariates = 0,
                                                                                                                       Covariates = "None"))
                                                                                    
                                                                                    # Fit all formulae within this fold
                                                                                    for (model_type in names(ModelConfigs)) {model_config <- ModelConfigs[[model_type]]
                                                                                                                             message("Dataset ", dataset_name, " | Fold ", fold_i, " | Model ", model_type)
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             Model <- INLA::inla(model_config$Formula,
                                                                                                                                                 family = "binomial",
                                                                                                                                                 Ntrials = Sample,
                                                                                                                                                 inla.mode = "experimental",
                                                                                                                                                 data = INLA::inla.stack.data(Stack),
                                                                                                                                                 control.family = list(link = "logit"),
                                                                                                                                                 control.inla = list(int.strategy = "auto"),
                                                                                                                                                 control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                                                          A = INLA::inla.stack.A(Stack),
                                                                                                                                                                          link = 1),    
                                                                                                                                                 control.compute = list(config = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                                                        dic = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                                                        waic = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                                                        cpo = TRUE),
                                                                                                                                                 verbose = verbose)
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             posterior_samples <- INLA::inla.posterior.sample(n = n_posterior, result = Model)
                                                                                                                             contents <- Model$misc$configs$contents
                                                                                                                             idIntercept <- get_latent_index(Model, "Intercept")
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             if (is.na(idIntercept)) {stop("Could not find Intercept in latent contents for ", dataset_name, 
                                                                                                                                                           " fold ", fold_i, " model ", model_type, ".", call. = FALSE)}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             has_spatial <- any(contents$tag == "s")
                                                                                                                             has_iid <- any(contents$tag == "i")
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             idSpace <- if (has_spatial) {get_spatial_indices(Model)} 
                                                                                                                                        else {NULL}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             model_covariates <- covariate_names[covariate_names %in% contents$tag]
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             if (length(model_covariates) > 0) {cov_ids <- sapply(model_covariates, function(v) get_latent_index(Model, v))
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             if (any(is.na(cov_ids))) {stop("Could not find latent fixed-effect index for covariate(s): ",
                                                                                                                                                            paste(model_covariates[is.na(cov_ids)], collapse = ", "), " in ", dataset_name, " fold ",
                                                                                                                                                            fold_i, " model ", model_type, ".", call. = FALSE)}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             cov_ids <- as.integer(cov_ids)
                                                                                                                             cov_matrix <- as.matrix(Unsampled[, model_covariates, drop = FALSE])} 
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             else {cov_ids <- integer(0)
                                                                                                                                   cov_matrix <- NULL}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             if (has_iid) {xHyper <- matrix(NA_real_,
                                                                                                                                                            nrow = length(posterior_samples[[1]]$hyperpar),
                                                                                                                                                            ncol = n_posterior)
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             for (j in seq_len(n_posterior)) {xHyper[, j] <- posterior_samples[[j]]$hyperpar}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             iid_effect <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(Unsampled), ncol = n_posterior)
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             for (j in seq_len(n_posterior)) {iid_effect[, j] <- stats::rnorm(nrow(Unsampled), mean = 0, sd = xHyper[nrow(xHyper), j]^(-0.5))}} 
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             else {iid_effect <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(Unsampled), ncol = n_posterior)}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             predictions <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(Unsampled), ncol = n_posterior)
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             for (j in seq_len(n_posterior)) {spatial_term <- if (has_spatial) {as.vector(A_Unsampled %*% posterior_samples[[j]]$latent[idSpace])}
                                                                                                                                                                              else {rep(0, nrow(Unsampled))}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                              iid_term <- iid_effect[, j]
                                                                                                                                                              fixed_intercept <- posterior_samples[[j]]$latent[idIntercept]
                                                                                                                                                              covariate_term <- if (length(model_covariates) > 0) {
                                                                                                                                                              fixed_covariates <- posterior_samples[[j]]$latent[cov_ids]
                                                                                                                                                              as.vector(cov_matrix %*% fixed_covariates)} 
                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                              else {rep(0, nrow(Unsampled))}
                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                              linear_pred <- fixed_intercept + spatial_term + iid_term + covariate_term
                                                                                                                                                              predictions[, j] <- stats::plogis(linear_pred)}     
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             prediction_summary <- data.frame(t(apply(predictions, 1, function(x) {c(Predicted = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                                                                                                                                     Predicted_sd = stats::sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                                                                                                                                     Predicted_q25 = unname(stats::quantile(x, probs = 0.25, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             na.rm = TRUE)),
                                                                                                                                                                                                     Predicted_q500 = unname(stats::quantile(x, probs = 0.500,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             na.rm = TRUE)),
                                                                                                                                                                                                     Predicted_q75 = unname(stats::quantile(x, probs = 0.75, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             na.rm = TRUE)))})))
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             prediction_results <- prediction_summary %>%
                                                                                                                                                   dplyr::mutate(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                                 ModelType = model_type,
                                                                                                                                                                 Fold = fold_i,
                                                                                                                                                                 Observed = Test_Prev$count / Test_Prev$total,
                                                                                                                                                                 Observed_percent = 100 * Test_Prev$count / Test_Prev$total,
                                                                                                                                                                 Predicted_percent = 100 * Predicted,
                                                                                                                                                                 Predicted_sd_percent = 100 * Predicted_sd,
                                                                                                                                                                 Predicted_q25_percent = 100 * Predicted_q25,
                                                                                                                                                                 Predicted_q500_percent = 100 * Predicted_q500,
                                                                                                                                                                 Predicted_q75_percent = 100 * Predicted_q75,
                                                                                                                                                                 total = Test_Prev$total,
                                                                                                                                                                 count = Test_Prev$count,
                                                                                                                                                                 value = Test_Prev$value,
                                                                                                                                                                 longitude = Test_Prev$longitude,
                                                                                                                                                                 latitude = Test_Prev$latitude,
                                                                                                                                                                 Cluster = Test_Prev$Cluster)
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             truth <- Test_Prev$count / Test_Prev$total
                                                                                                                             pred <- prediction_summary$Predicted
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             MAE <- mean(abs(pred - truth), na.rm = TRUE)
                                                                                                                             RMSE <- sqrt(mean((pred - truth)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
                                                                                                                             R <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(pred, truth, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             MeanLogCPO <- suppressWarnings(mean(log(Model$cpo$cpo[Model$cpo$cpo > 0]), na.rm = TRUE))
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             fold_metrics <- tibble::tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                            ModelType = model_type,
                                                                                                                                                            Fold = fold_i,
                                                                                                                                                            N_Train = nrow(Train_Prev),
                                                                                                                                                            N_Test = nrow(Test_Prev),
                                                                                                                                                            N_Covariates = model_config$N_Covariates,
                                                                                                                                                            Covariates = model_config$Covariates,
                                                                                                                                                            DIC = Model$dic$dic,
                                                                                                                                                            WAIC = Model$waic$waic,
                                                                                                                                                            Mean_Log_CPO = MeanLogCPO,
                                                                                                                                                            Negative_Mean_Log_CPO = -MeanLogCPO,
                                                                                                                                                            MAE = MAE,
                                                                                                                                                            RMSE = RMSE,
                                                                                                                                                            R = R)
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             result_name <- paste(dataset_name, model_type, fold_i, sep = "_")
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             FoldEvaluationResults[[result_name]] <- fold_metrics
                                                                                                                             FoldPredictionResults[[result_name]] <- prediction_results}}
                                                        
                                                        # Summaries
                                                        EvaluationSummary <- dplyr::bind_rows(FoldEvaluationResults)
                                                        
                                                        EvaluationMean <- EvaluationSummary %>%
                                                                          dplyr::group_by(Dataset, ModelType) %>%
                                                                          dplyr::summarise(N_Folds = dplyr::n(),
                                                                                           Total_Test_N = sum(N_Test, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           Mean_MAE = mean(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           SD_MAE = stats::sd(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           Mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           SD_RMSE = stats::sd(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           Mean_R = mean(R, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           SD_R = stats::sd(R, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           Mean_DIC = mean(DIC, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           SD_DIC = stats::sd(DIC, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           Mean_WAIC = mean(WAIC, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           SD_WAIC = stats::sd(WAIC, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           Mean_Negative_Mean_Log_CPO = mean(Negative_Mean_Log_CPO, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                           SD_Negative_Mean_Log_CPO = stats::sd(Negative_Mean_Log_CPO, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
                                                                          dplyr::arrange(Mean_RMSE)
                                                        
                                                        PredictionResults <- dplyr::bind_rows(FoldPredictionResults)
                                                        
                                                        OverallCorrelation <- PredictionResults %>%
                                                                              dplyr::group_by(Dataset, ModelType) %>%
                                                                              dplyr::summarise(Overall_R = stats::cor(Predicted, Observed, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"), .groups = "drop")
                                                        
                                                        EvaluationMean <- EvaluationMean %>%
                                                                          dplyr::left_join(OverallCorrelation, by = c("Dataset", "ModelType")) %>%
                                                                          distinct()
                                                                                                                
                                                        if (isTRUE(export)) {openxlsx::write.xlsx(list(Fold_metrics = EvaluationSummary,
                                                                                                       Mean_metrics = EvaluationMean,
                                                                                                       Prediction_results = PredictionResults,
                                                                                                       Fold_assignment = fold_table),
                                                                                                  file = file.path(dataset_output_dir, paste0("Final/", dataset_name, "_CV_all_formulae.xlsx")), overwrite = TRUE)}
                                                        
                                                        message("Finished cross-validation for: ", dataset_name)
                                                        
                                                        list(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                             Fold_assignment = fold_table,
                                                             EvaluationSummary = EvaluationSummary,
                                                             EvaluationMean = EvaluationMean,
                                                             PredictionResults = PredictionResults,
                                                             output_dir = dataset_output_dir)}

CV_Dataset8 <- CrossValidate_INLA_Dataset8(Data = Datasets2[["Dataset 8"]],
                                           dataset_name = "Dataset 8",
                                           ADM0_path = "Input/ADM0.gpkg",
                                           output_root = "Output/",
                                           covariate_names = c("Population",
                                                               "Malaria",
                                                               "Urbanization",
                                                               "Consanguinity",
                                                               "EFI",
                                                               "Counselling"),
                                           K = 5,
                                           seed = 123,
                                           n_posterior = 1000,
                                           verbose = TRUE,
                                           export = TRUE)

openxlsx::write.xlsx(CV_Dataset8$EvaluationSummary, file = paste0("Output/Final/Validation-Individual.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(CV_Dataset8$EvaluationMean, file = paste0("Output/Final/ValidationMetrics.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
